mcq.question: What is the essential difference between textkit's `case.hpp` and `stats.hpp`?

options.A: `case.hpp` is C code and `stats.hpp` is C++
options.B: `stats.hpp` functions are faster because they are compiled
options.C: Only `case.hpp` can be included from several files
options.D: `case.hpp` defines its functions inline in the header, while `stats.hpp` only declares functions whose code is in a compiled library that must be linked

mcq.explanation: Header-only code is compiled into every translation unit that includes it. A compiled library is built once and linked; forgetting to link it gives 'undefined reference' errors.

mcq.question: Does version `1.10.0` satisfy the requirement `^1.9.0`?

options.A: Yes: same major version 1, and 1.10.0 is newer than 1.9.0
options.B: No: 1.10 is smaller than 1.9 when compared as text
options.D: Only if the patch number is also 9

mcq.explanation: Version parts compare as numbers, so 10 > 9. A caret requirement accepts any version with the same major number that is at least the given one.
